description.html: The SOBO SD-9W is an LED clip light with a ring-shaped light source. It clips onto the aquarium rim, and according to the packaging the holder rotates 360 degrees, so the light is easy to aim and the lamp fits aquariums of different shapes. Installation is simple and needs no tools.

The ring lights a larger area, so the light is even and soft, without harsh shadows. The manufacturer also lists flicker-free operation and a spectrum that supports plant growth. The lamp suits smaller and nano aquariums without a lid that need more light than a mini lamp gives.

Switch aquarium lighting on and off at the same times every day, ideally with a timer, so fish and plants have a steady day-night rhythm. Too much light and direct sunlight encourage algae. Wipe limescale and dust off the lamp from time to time, as deposits reduce light output.
